segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Welcome to the Health Association.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: My name is Julia.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: How can I help you?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, I'm just calling to schedule a consultation with one of your online doctors for a chronic condition that I have.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We can do that.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Do you have an account with us already?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I do not.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, so then you'll need to go to our website and create an account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And from there, I can help you schedule a consultation, or we can do that, or you can do that yourself online.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I would be able to do this over the phone.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I'm not very comfortable with working with things online.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yep, that is totally fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Are you familiar with how to create an account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, I think actually my son just helped me create it, so we should be good to go to schedule the appointment.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can you tell me the username associated with your account, please?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, it's O -W -E -N -H -E -L -T -H.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, just to confirm, that is O -N -H -E -L -T -H.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And can you confirm your date of birth, please?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And your health card number, please?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: AB 372949HH -ON.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, perfect.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is a match.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, yes, you'd like to schedule a consultation.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What type of doctor are you looking for?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Dermatologist.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: A dermatologist.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And when would you like this appointment?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Would you be able to have any availability this week or I guess next week since it's Friday?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Absolutely.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, we're mostly first -come, first -serve.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, what that means is you will submit your request for a consultation, and as a doctor becomes available, you will wait in the queue, and then the doctor will arrive and ask you a bunch of questions.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And how long will I have to wait in the queue?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That varies, but we're generally very quick.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Less than 20 minutes is how we work.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: If it ends up being more than that, then we will have them reach out to you personally afterwards.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, because my friend recommended me to your service, and they've been speaking with Dr. Bramson, and so I just wanted to see if I would be able to also request him directly instead of having to get a random doctor assigned to me.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, his next appointment availability will be on Wednesday at 2 .30.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, that should work.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Then I will book you in.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Would I be able to send you a confirmation at that same email address that you provided me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Or rather, okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, you can.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, yes.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: If you just do that email, that username, but at gmail .com, you can send it there.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, that should be arriving into your inbox shortly.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And so,

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Is there anything I need to do to prepare for this appointment or will it be fine just to show up as is?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: that is also included in your confirmation email.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It tells you everything you need to bring to your appointment, including your health card number and some other form of identification, as well as the current medications that you're on, how long you've had the condition that you want to discuss, what the condition is, and so on.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Just like general information that will help the doctor get up to speed as quickly as possible,

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: and you will be taken to a form to fill that out once you click the confirmation email.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, you'll fill out all that information that will get sent to the doctor, and they will be able to review that before your appointment, confirm those details at your appointment with you once it begins, and then your appointment commences.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And how long does the appointment usually last?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, I've booked you in for 30 minutes to start.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Would you like me to extend that to longer?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I think 30 minutes should be fine.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I just want to make sure that I'm getting seen in an appropriate amount of time because often doctors seem to be in a hurry, and then you only get five minutes out of them before you rush out the door.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I understand.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is why we have this wonderful service here.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We're very considerate of doctor's times, but also patient's times.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And we want to make sure that we have the appropriate length of appointments and that doctors show up at their appointment times.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Great.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And then would I also be able to get a prescription refill through you right now?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Absolutely.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me just go over to that section in your profile.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, and which prescription would you need to be refilled, sir?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I can't remember the name of it, but it's an antibiotic ointment that I use for my skin.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I'm just running low, and you should be on there.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay, do you know the last time you refilled it?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It was about two months ago.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I do see one for two months ago, approximately.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The other ones are much older, so it is safe to assume that the two month ago one is the one that you want.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yeah, I think I'm looking at the bottle and it says amoxicillin.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Perfect.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yeah, that checks out.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, I will trigger the refill for you, and you'll get an email of your prescription pickup that you can send to the pharmacy of your choice.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Perfect.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And then if I need to get lab tests done, obviously this is an online service, so how does that work?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, lab tests will be requisitioned for you from your doctor.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, following your consultation that you have on Wednesday, the doctor will either request or not some specific lab tests for you, and those will be sent to you electronically to print off.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And then do I just need to find a place myself to get them done or will they pick a specific place near me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It will depend on the test.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, for example, for blood tests, there are usually many around in any area.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, you'll be able to locate the closest one to you and either make an appointment with them or walk in, depending on the type of clinic.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: But if it is something more like something,

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: maybe an ultrasound, that will go through us, depending on how close you are to one of our facilities.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That sounds good.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So just to confirm, I have an appointment at 2 30 on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is correct.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And then they will let me know if I need any lab work done, and I just need to fill out the forms that are in the confirmation email.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And from there, from there, it will tell you how you would like to meet this doctor.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, you can do it over the phone, or you could do it over video chat, and the link to the video chat will be sent to you if you select that option.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That sounds good to me.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you for your help today.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You're very welcome.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And I guess I won't be seeing you, but thank you again.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Bye -bye.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So, let me know if you have any more questions.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Feel free to call us.
